title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: download symbols from Microsoft’s public NuGet source.
summary: AL Language Extension version 17 introduces a new command to download app symbols directly from Microsoft's public NuGet feeds, making it easier to manage dependencies without manually downloading from a specific environment or sharing symbols across projects.
key_points: AL Language Extension version 17 adds 'AL: Download Symbols from Global Sources' command in VS Code
Symbols download automatically based on the application version specified in app.json
Country/region-specific packages can be selected during download
New settings allow configuring custom NuGet feeds and restricting downloads to only custom sources
features: AL: Download Symbols from Global Sources

quotes.text: starting from AL Language Extension version 17, now you have a new command called AL: Download Symbols from Global Sources.
quotes.why_it_matters: Marks the introduction of a significant feature for managing AL project dependencies more efficiently

quotes.text: Symbols are autyomatically downloaded from the Microsoft NuGet feed accordingly to the version you've specified in your app.json file
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the automatic version matching behavior that eliminates manual symbol management
